egressNote: This discovery run was performed from an egress in Lithuania (LT), not the United States. Five sources refuse connections from here: the county assessor portal (DNS resolves, TCP connect times out), the Illinois Secretary of State business search (HTTP 403 from an Akamai edge on every path), the Better Business Bureau (HTTP 403), and the Rock Island and Milan permit portals (HTTP 403). A non-US egress cannot distinguish a geo-block from a bot challenge, so those sources are recorded as unreachable from this egress — not as absent, and not as bot-protected. Re-probing from a US exit is the single action that would upgrade these rows from recorded-unreachable to measured. Every other source below was reached and measured.

sources.name: Rock Island County GIS — Parcels (parcel_layer)
sources.publisher: Rock Island County GIS (ArcGIS Online org 6FnscPPlUa9DXXOk, urlKey "ricogis")
sources.accessMethod: Anonymous ArcGIS REST query, no token and no session. esriGeometryPolygon geometry, f=geojson and outSR=4326 both verified. Paginate 33 requests at maxRecordCount 2000, or take the 19 MB shapefile bulk export from https://hub.arcgis.com/api/download/v1/items/9cae8a64ab0e4cea99758f741ca43b3c/shapefile?layers=0
sources.throughput: p50 0.46 s, p95 0.79 s over 10 rapid sequential queries (2026-08-12); zero 429, zero throttling. Bulk: shapefile 19,163,379 B in 4.8 s; csv 46,916,439 B in 7.6 s; geojson 183,669,886 B in 15.5 s; kml 336,984,388 B in 24.8 s.
sources.constraints: maxRecordCount 2000 is a hard per-request cap (33 pages for a full extract). Hub export is a cached snapshot and drifts from live — 66,028 export features vs 65,955 live. Hub export renames 6 fields and drops 4 (82 REST fields vs 79 export properties). geoPackage and filegdb return HTTP 400 from the Hub endpoint despite being advertised in supportedExportFormats. gross_acres is 0 for 72.5% of parcels — use GIS_acres_num. Empty values are "" or " ", never NULL. The county on-prem service gis.rockislandcountyil.gov/.../Hosted/Parcels returns 499 Token Required and must not be used.
sources.licence: For use by the general public

sources.name: Rock Island County zoning and property-class codes (attributes of the GIS parcel layer)
sources.accessMethod: Anonymous ArcGIS REST. Zoning and class arrive as attributes of the parcel layer; there is no separate zoning FeatureServer. Distinct values read with returnDistinctValues, counts with groupByFieldsForStatistics.
sources.throughput: p50 0.46 s per query, same layer as the parcels row
sources.constraints: NOT a countywide zoning classification. For 51,039 parcels (77.4%) the Zoning field holds a three-letter MUNICIPALITY code (MOL, RI, EM, SIL, MIL, CV, CCL, HAM, PB, AND, COR, OAK, REY), not a zoning class — the county records zoning only for the unincorporated area it governs. Only 13,770 parcels (20.9%) carry a real county zoning class (AG1, AG2, B1-B4, I1, I2, R1, R2, R5, R7, SE1, SE2, RC, PUD); 1,146 (1.7%) are empty or null. Municipal zoning for Moline, Rock Island, East Moline and Silvis (43,531 parcels, two-thirds of the county) must be sourced from each municipality separately and was not attempted in this run. 3,152 parcels carry an undocumented "!" or "?" suffix on the zoning code whose meaning is unknown. The class field has 23 distinct 4-digit codes whose code->label table lives on the unreachable assessor portal, so commercial/industrial eligibility is NOT YET MAPPED.

sources.name: Rock Island County Recorder — land records via Fidlar Tapestry
sources.publisher: Rock Island County Recorder, on the Fidlar Tapestry platform
sources.throughput: not-measured
sources.constraints: www.landrecords.com answers the 301 normally (HTTP 301 in 0.30 s, so that host is alive), but tapestry.fidlar.com returns NO A record and NO AAAA record from this resolver — verdict dns-unresolved. This is a DIFFERENT failure mode from the assessor portal's tcp-blocked and must not be conflated with it. A DNS failure does not prove the service is retired; a split-horizon or geo-aware DNS answer is equally consistent. Tapestry is additionally a PAY-PER-SEARCH commercial product in most counties, so even reachable it would not be a free bulk source. REACHABLE SUBSTITUTE for the ownership-tenure question: the parcel layer's own date_last_sale, gross_sale_price and net_sale_price fields — last sale only, not the deed chain, with date_last_sale null for some parcels, date_of_sale null for all, and sale prices of 10 appearing as nominal non-arm's-length consideration.

unavailableSignals.whatWasChecked: Permit portals, all 16 jurisdictions: No countywide roofing-permit history is publicly queryable. 11 of 16 jurisdictions have no online permit lookup at all; Rock Island and Milan are unreachable from this egress; the two reachable portals cannot be searched by parcel, and East Moline requires an exact permit number.; Parcel layer YRBuilt field: Populated for 53,409 of 65,955 parcels (81.0%), measured 2026-08-12. This is BUILDING age, not roof age — a lower bound only for a building that has never been re-roofed, which is not the population the question asks about. Stored as a string with " " for unpopulated.; Assessor portal (DEVNET Wedge): unreachable from this egress — contents unknown, not absent. May carry roof material/condition.; Historic aerials: not evaluated. Imagery would be a computer-vision project, not a data source.
unavailableSignals.uiStatement: No public roof-age source was found for Rock Island County. We checked all 16 permit jurisdictions (11 have no online permit lookup at all, and none supports parcel-keyed roofing permit search), the county parcel layer's YRBuilt field, and the assessor portal. YRBuilt is the year the building was built, not the year the roof was replaced, so we do not offer it as roof age.

unavailableSignals.whatWasChecked: USGS National Hydrography Dataset (NHD): Reachable, HTTP 200 in 0.96 s (2026-08-12). Layer 12 "Waterbody - Large Scale" returns 962 features over the county bbox. Public federal data. Gives WATER LOCATION, not view.; Structure-height data for line-of-sight: No public structure-height dataset found for this county. Without it, line-of-sight cannot be computed, so a genuine "view" cannot be derived.; County contour / terrain services: Contour services exist (Contours, Contours_Vector_Tile), giving partial terrain — insufficient alone for line-of-sight.
unavailableSignals.uiStatement: No public water-view source was found for Rock Island County. A view is a line-of-sight computation requiring terrain and structure heights, and no public structure-height source exists for this county. We can offer distance to the nearest water body from USGS NHD data — that is a proxy, not a view: a parcel 50 m from the Mississippi behind a levee has no view and this data cannot tell the difference.

unavailableSignals.whatWasChecked: MetroLINK / MetroQC (the Quad Cities transit operator): Reachable, HTTP 200 — gogreenmetro.com now 301-redirects here. No GTFS or developer resource published; /gtfs, /gtfs.zip, /google_transit.zip and /developer all return 404.; transitfeeds.com: HTTP 403 from this egress — not readable here.; transit.land API: HTTP 401 Unauthorized — requires an API key we do not hold.; Mobility Database API: Requires authentication — "Invalid GCIP ID token". Not evaluated further.; OpenStreetMap bus stops via Overpass: 119 highway=bus_stop features in the county bbox, measured 2026-08-12, ODbL. This IS a usable public source for stop locations.
unavailableSignals.uiStatement: Transit proximity for Rock Island County is backed by OpenStreetMap bus-stop data — 119 stops in the county area, licensed ODbL. No authoritative GTFS feed was located: the MetroLINK site publishes none, and transitfeeds, transit.land and the Mobility Database all require keys or block this egress. So we can say a property is near a stop, but not how often that stop is served, and OSM completeness is not guaranteed.

This is a count of OSM features, not a verified count of operating stores: a licensed in-store Starbucks inside a grocery store or hotel may be tagged under the host business and missed, a closed location may persist, and the search area crosses the Mississippi into Iowa so some may be outside the county.
